summary: This best current practice describes how to reduce the harm from maintenance work by deliberately tearing down BGP sessions that will be affected, before the work begins. Traffic then shifts to other paths in a controlled way instead of being dropped when the link or device fails. It includes guidance for both ordinary IP networks and Internet Exchange Points.

eli5.summary: Before turning off a water pipe for repairs, you tell everyone to use a different tap first. Routers hang up on each other politely before maintenance, so nothing gets spilled.

questions: how to avoid traffic loss during network maintenance
